hypothesis: Y025 demonstrated benefit at drift=1; Y026 found zero legal cached preferences at drift=5. A preregistered dose-response at drift=1,3,5 should localize where bounded observed-memory ceases to have legal applicability.
freeze: Freeze all three dose levels, cohort, arms, capacity, evaluation thresholds and scientific outcome categories before original run. Report every dose; do not select a favorable dose post-result.
generator: Same Y025 and Y026 active-key sequence and four-key collision geometry, seven active motif keys of sixteen identities/cells, nine inactive retained slots, radius two, eight episodes per seed; only home drift coefficient D changes in (7*key+seed+D*episode) mod16.
arms: legal cache-read under identical nine-slot write protocol
primary: Per-dose, per-seed returning-key churn savings, legal prior-assignment preferences, total matching calls, cache write parity, independent exhaustive Hall validity. MONOTONE_DECAY if aggregate heldout churn savings strictly decrease from drift1 through drift3 to drift5; OTHERWISE_NONMONOTONE if not. Report separately whether each dose has benefit/neutral/harm.
safeguards: Exact prior source identity, no future-data policy input, no post-selection, no hidden capacity growth; original first-use artifact; final full Yggdrasil regression.
explicit_workload: Three preregistered geometric conditions, 3x experimental evaluations versus single-drift runs; underlying scientific memory and action capacities unchanged.
claim_limit: Synthetic finite matching cache validity boundary; no learned cognitive memory, development or promotion authority.
